requirements.title: Country neutral reusable engines
requirements.requirement: All jurisdiction names, institutions, source catalogues, legal policy and research live in deployment data. Generic packages, prompts, migrations and fixtures contain no country-specific research.

requirements.title: Private operation and owner release control
requirements.requirement: Research, correspondence, submissions and creative outputs default to private. Outbound questions and public releases use separate purpose-scoped authorization.

requirements.title: Accessible report intake
requirements.requirement: People can submit accounts and evidence without payment, legal representation or polished paperwork; resumable multilingual forms, pseudonymous options and bounded status are supported.

requirements.title: Thorough factual investigation
requirements.requirement: Every accepted case has questions, competing explanations, a research and outreach plan, reviewable findings, unresolved issues and a documented closure or reopening decision.

requirements.title: Knowledgeable contact discovery
requirements.requirement: Identify appropriate people or record custodians from relevant professional sources, record why they may know, and verify the published contact route; channel verification alone does not prove authorship or truth.

requirements.title: Concise honest autonomous outreach
requirements.requirement: Send short, accurate, clearly identified automated research inquiries under owner-configured authorization; handle replies, refusals, corrections and bounded follow-up.

requirements.title: Familiar inbox and human takeover
requirements.requirement: Provide inbox, sent, drafts, archive, search, labels, attachments, threads, assignment and an atomic switch to human control, with any already-dispatched message visibly in flight.

requirements.title: Systematic collection
requirements.requirement: Discover repositories and datasets, crawl permitted sources, capture originals and track retrieval failures, pagination, refreshes and coverage gaps.

requirements.title: Evidence preservation and provenance
requirements.requirement: Retain original versions, acquisition records, cryptographic digests, handling events and derivation relationships without confusing integrity with authenticity or truth.

requirements.title: Multimodal processing
requirements.requirement: OCR, transcription, translation, diarization and metadata extraction preserve original text, geometry, timecodes and review history.

requirements.title: Evidence linked knowledge
requirements.requirement: Represent events, people, organizations, actions, source dependence and claims; require evidence for attributed involvement and retain uncertainty.

requirements.title: Verification and challenge
requirements.requirement: Test answers and claims against primary material, source independence, counterevidence and alternative explanations; preserve unresolved or adverse findings.

requirements.title: Parallel persistent agents
requirements.requirement: Delegate bounded work to reusable agent roles with durable memory, least privilege, budgets, checkpoints, retries and inspectable results.

requirements.title: Visual audit everywhere
requirements.requirement: Each module exposes understandable states, transitions, provenance, decisions and failures through accessible visual views plus tables and text.

requirements.title: Victim centered storytelling
requirements.requirement: Develop testimony-based points of view, scenes, scripts, story structure, cinematography and sound while labeling inference, reconstruction and invented material.

requirements.title: Actual production across media
requirements.requirement: Produce and edit films, animation, images, music, audio, written work and interactive experiences through replaceable tool adapters and reproducible asset manifests.

requirements.title: Long term creative catalogue
requirements.requirement: Maintain series, collections, reusable approved assets, translations, collaborators and versioned production projects across years.

requirements.title: Rights consent and dignity
requirements.requirement: Record permissions by purpose, identity, asset, territory, audience and term; distinguish source citation from reproducing or adapting an asset.

requirements.title: Controlled publication and distribution
requirements.requirement: Prepare private review packages, accessible releases, source companions, licensed distributions and optional public pages with explicit version-bound release authorization.

requirements.title: Corrections through the whole chain
requirements.requirement: Propagate source or consent changes to claims, tasks, scenes, renders, exports and releases; retain version history and require affected decisions to be renewed.

requirements.title: Commercial sustainability
requirements.requirement: Track budgets, contributors, agreements, licenses, distribution revenue, expenses and project margins independently of factual conclusions.

requirements.title: Distinct operating identities
requirements.requirement: Separate deployments, organizations, publishing identities, satirical work and campaign-related activity through explicit projects, accounts and access.

requirements.title: Accountability and professional reuse
requirements.requirement: Create research reports, record requests, case chronologies, referral packages, evidence indexes and public-service materials; support citizen and professional investigations.

requirements.title: Global and external operation
requirements.requirement: Support different languages, legal systems, institutions, calendars and hosting regions; external operators can investigate public material without depending on the institution being investigated.

requirements.title: Balanced effort allocation
requirements.requirement: Use configurable research lanes and auditable active-work accounting to allocate equal or otherwise specified effort without setting quotas for adverse conclusions.

requirements.title: Operational reliability and recovery
requirements.requirement: Provide isolation, backups, restoration, encryption, monitoring, rollback, cost controls and source-bound acceptance evidence.

requirements.title: Interoperability and portability
requirements.requirement: Expose versioned APIs, events, SDKs and export bundles; avoid provider lock-in and support scoped offline review.

requirements.title: Reuse existing intake work
requirements.requirement: Consume the Secure Intake and Case Workflow Engine through its pinned image and versioned integration contract, extending generic gaps upstream.

requirements.title: Research continuity before deployment
requirements.requirement: Preserve existing research outside engine repositories, then import it into the private deployment with reconciliation and provenance-gap records.

requirements.title: Observable autonomy and operator control
requirements.requirement: Show objectives, task dependencies, agents, progress, costs, correspondence and production; allow pause, cancellation, reassignment and bounded escalation.
